name: Bite
description: A tearing bite. On a strong or critical hit, the target suffers bleeding (2 x tier).

name: Claw
description: A raking strike with claws or talons.

name: Gore
description: A charge with horns or tusks. After moving at least a short distance in a straight line, this creature gains +1 boon on this attack, and on a hit increases the success level by one step (max. critical).

name: Stomp
description: This creature can only use this attack if they skip all Movement this turn, before and after the attack. On a strong or critical hit, the target falls prone.

name: Tail Sweep
description: Targets every creature in melee range. On a strong hit the target is pushed close. On a critical hit they are pushed close and fall prone.

name: Slam
description: A heavy blow from a limb, root, or mass of matter. On a strong or critical hit, the target falls prone.

name: Constrict
description: On a hit, the target is grappled and restrained. While grappling, this attack can't be used against any other target.

name: Venomous Sting
description: The target also takes secondary poison damage (ignore AV). On a strong or critical hit, the target is briefly poisoned. They can roll Strength + Fortitude at the end of their turns to end it early.

name: Sword Strike
description: A direct strike with a bladed weapon.

name: Spear Thrust
description: A thrust with a hafted weapon, made at close range.

name: Dagger Stab
description: A quick stab with a light blade. On a strong or critical hit, the target suffers bleeding (2 x tier).

name: Arrow Shot
description: A shot from a bow or sling at range.

name: Caustic Spit
description: A ranged glob of venom or acid. The target also takes secondary acid damage (ignore AV). On a strong or critical hit, the target is briefly blinded.

name: Breath Weapon
description: Roll Strength + Fortitude vs. Dodge. Targets every creature in a cone. Choose the damage type to match the creature. On a strong or critical hit, each target also suffers burning (2 x tier) briefly. Carries the property recharge (d4).

name: Wide Swing
description: Targets every opponent in melee range at half weapon damage, which is the standing rule for a multi-target attack.

name: Spectral Touch
description: A cold, insubstantial touch. On a strong or critical hit, the target's maximum HP is reduced by the damage dealt until they finish a long rest.
